explanation: The theorem says the left adjoint mate of a map in FGModuleCat is the transpose (dualMap). The LeftRigidCategory structure on FGModuleCat is built in this library's Rigid.lean, so Mathlib has no statement about it. I searched Mathlib/Algebra/Category for leftAdjointMate, rightAdjointMate, dualMap and FGModuleCat dual lemmas and found nothing. The generic leftAdjointMate lemmas in Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Rigid/Basic.lean (leftAdjointMate_comp_evaluation and others) concern arbitrary categories. The proof uses leftAdjointMate_comp_evaluation as one ingredient, but the result is not a special case of it.
